data.one_liner: Pre-built widgets and utilities for integrating Firebase Firestore into Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-to-use Flutter widgets specifically designed to work seamlessly with Firebase Firestore, reducing boilerplate for common queries and lists. It handles UI updates based on database streams and data changes.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app backed by Cloud Firestore
You need standard list or query views driven directly by Firestore data
You want to minimize boilerplate for rendering Firestore collections
avoid_when: Your app does not use Firebase Firestore
You require a completely custom low-level UI completely detached from standard widgets
strengths: Saves time on boilerplate UI for Firestore integration
Stream-based reactive updates out of the box
weaknesses: Limited customization if your design requirements deviate heavily from standard layouts
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up Firebase in your Flutter project, including platform-specific configuration files.

alternatives.name: cloud_firestore
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer handling the raw data streams and building your own custom UI widgets from scratch.
